purpose: Handoff catalog: real ARES-1 events, proposed Watchtower mapping and honest statuses. Source of truth is the committed IDL and the emit! sites in the game program.

sourceOfTruth.programSource: game/programs/solana_potato/src/lib.rs (4429 lines; event structs at ~3462-3665 and 4422)
sourceOfTruth.note: game/apps/web/src/idl.json is the compiled Anchor IDL snapshot; watchtower/scripts/sync-idl.mjs fails if events/ares1-event-map.json drifts from it.

watchtowerContractObserved.ingestEndpoint: POST /api/ingest/solana (on-chain facts; the hub also accepts chain:"offchain" here)
watchtowerContractObserved.trafficgenEndpoint: POST /api/ingest/trafficgen is TalkChart only and MUST NOT receive ARES-1 game telemetry
watchtowerContractObserved.reality: Only RewardGranted exists on chain. The hub adapter list is a name allowlist, so real events (Harvested, FieldCreated, AchievementClaimed, ...) will not be recognized until the hub's list/mapping is updated or ARES-1 agrees to different event names. ARES-1 will not rename on-chain events without a coordinated program upgrade.
watchtowerContractObserved.identityNote: Hub projections prefer payload.playerKey; ARES-1 events carry real source field names (owner/recipient/buyer/user/seller/destination/referrer). Mapping must be agreed explicitly.
watchtowerContractObserved.offchainIdentityNote: Hub offchainIdentity() uses provider + campaignId/pageId/sessionId/seq; ARES-1 has none of those identifiers today (no campaigns, pages, client sessions). Do not invent them.

notEmittedByAres1.name: PlayerJoined
notEmittedByAres1.reason: No on-chain or off-chain join event exists; the game has no player profile/registration write on chain.
notEmittedByAres1.nextStep: requires a real join event on the game side or explicit approval to treat wallet-connect telemetry as join

notEmittedByAres1.name: PotatoPlanted
notEmittedByAres1.reason: There is no planting instruction/event; yield accrues over time from a created field (create_field / presale purchase).

notEmittedByAres1.name: PotatoHarvested
notEmittedByAres1.reason: The on-chain event name is Harvested (single) and BatchHarvested (batch); the adapter name does not exist.

notEmittedByAres1.name: TokenMinted
notEmittedByAres1.reason: No TokenMinted event is emitted; minting happens inside harvest/batch_harvest/grant_reward and is only observable through Harvested / BatchHarvested / RewardGranted / RewardGrantedOnce.

notEmittedByAres1.name: TokenBurned
notEmittedByAres1.reason: No TokenBurned event is emitted; burns are internal CPIs (field purchase, repair, upgrade, tax, fertilizer, market fee share) without a dedicated event.

notEmittedByAres1.name: TreasuryChanged
notEmittedByAres1.reason: Treasury movements are itemised per verb, not by a generic TreasuryChanged event.

notEmittedByAres1.name: WalletConnected
notEmittedByAres1.reason: Client-side wallet adapters connect locally; no telemetry is sent anywhere (no analytics endpoint in web or backend).
notEmittedByAres1.nextStep: requires a client telemetry collector, privacy basis and contract - not in scope for this handoff

notEmittedByAres1.name: SessionStarted / SessionEnded
notEmittedByAres1.reason: No sessionId exists in the program, backend or client.

notEmittedByAres1.name: PackPurchased
notEmittedByAres1.reason: Off-chain Phase-1 packs exist only as backend presale orders; there is no emitter to the hub and no session/campaign ids for the hub's offchainIdentity contract.
notEmittedByAres1.closestRealEvent: backend presale order state machine (DB only)

notEmittedByAres1.name: PaymentSettled
notEmittedByAres1.reason: Off-chain presale payments are matched to orders in the backend DB (tx_signature), but nothing is emitted to the hub.

notEmittedByAres1.name: RetentionDay1 / RetentionDay7
notEmittedByAres1.reason: Retention is not computed anywhere; no raw entry/session events exist to derive it. The hub must design the calculation from whatever real events it gets, or wait for client telemetry.

notEmittedByAres1.name: CrossGameEntry
notEmittedByAres1.reason: No cross-game program, bridge instruction, bridge event or shared identity service exists in ARES-1; only an in-game lore string mentions a future burn-based bridge to Age of Farming.

notEmittedByAres1.name: PurchaseCompleted (generic)
notEmittedByAres1.reason: Only two real on-chain purchase rails map here today: PresalePurchase (field presale, resource from the emitting instruction) and ExportLicensePurchased (SKR). Off-chain pack purchases are not emitted.

realFacts: delivered / refunded / expired / cancelled with timestamps and tx_signature
offchainSources.reason: No push/export path to the hub exists; the hub's offchainIdentity() cannot be satisfied by these fields as-is.

realFacts: reward intents with nonce and status
append-only ledger mirror of finalized reward events with signature/slot/block_time
offchainSources.reason: Internal admin/ops data; no emitter. Must not be shipped without an agreed privacy basis and dedup contract.

realFacts: wallet connect/disconnect happens locally; no analytics or telemetry calls are made (only static asset fetches)
offchainSources.reason: There is no client telemetry collector to hand over.

location.reason: No region/location state, tag or map exists in the game; the hub must not derive geography for ARES-1.

crossGame.reason: No bridge/linking feature, program or event; nothing to map to BridgeIn/BridgeOut/CrossGameLinked/CrossGameAssetGranted.

hours.reason: Playtime is not measured or stored anywhere (no foreground/background tracking, no AFK rules).

rank.definition: floor(active fields / 3) + 1, computed client-side in game/apps/web/src/contexts/GameContext.tsx:203 from on-chain field accounts
rank.range: unbounded in code (practically 1..N for N/3 fields)
rank.reason: Not stored server-side; it would have to be reconstructed from chain state. Values shown to a user are not an authoritative progress record.

operatorGameProgress.note: POST /api/games/progress is HMAC-protected and is a separate Operator Game protocol; ARES-1 does not currently produce wallet/hours/rank/updatedAt and will not simulate them.

knownGaps: Deployed binary provenance is unverified: the last devnet deploy (slot 507112076, 2026-10-03) is not verified-build and the committed IDL is only proven for the three sampled event types.
Only 3 of 31 event types have captured runtime evidence.
The exporter has not run its certified devnet smoke (no RPC egress from the sandbox and no exporter token/DB/URL); no central handshake has happened.
Hub adapter names for ares1 mostly do not exist on chain - mapping agreement is the single biggest blocker.
Off-chain facts exist in PostgreSQL but have no event contract (no eventId/session/seq) and no emitter.
